# Diana Barry & Jane Andrews

- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Friend of — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — friends sitting together in the audience · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P11](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P16](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0016)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to inspect her. After driving over with Jane and [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels insecure among the sophisticated attendees, but when overcome by stage fright on platform, the sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) motivates her to perform splendidly and earn an encore.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the stage for an encore performance to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests at the concert. Afterwards, she dines with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, introduced to everyone by the pink lady, before [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives them home under the moonlight while they discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment.
>
